metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1965 · The Flight of the Phoenix
metas.description: After an oil company plane crashes in the Sahara, the survivors' hopes are buoyed by one of the passengers, an airplane designer who comes up with a plan to build a flyable plane from the wreckage.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1957 · 3:10 to Yuma
metas.description: Broke small-time rancher Dan Evans is hired by the stagecoach line to put big-time captured outlaw leader Ben Wade on the 3:10 train to Yuma but Wade's gang tries to free him.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1966 · Don't Look Now... We're Being Shot At!
metas.description: Several ordinary Frenchmen go on an epic voyage through the occupied country to the free zone as they help British pilots avoid German captivity.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1941 · High Sierra
metas.description: After being released from prison, notorious thief Roy Earle is hired by his old boss to help a group of inexperienced criminals plan and carry out the robbery of a California resort.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1934 · L'Atalante
metas.description: Newly married couple Juliette and a ship captain Jean struggle through marriage as they travel on the L'atalante along with the captain's first mate Le père Jules and a cabin boy.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1969 · The Diamond Arm
metas.description: An ordinary Soviet citizen accidentally intervenes into a huge operation of international criminal group that trades illegally obtained jewelry.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1966 · The Sand Pebbles
metas.description: In 1926, a U.S. Naval engineer gets assigned to a gunboat on a rescue mission in war-torn China.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1939 · Only Angels Have Wings
metas.description: At a remote South American trading port, the manager of an air-freight company is compelled to risk the lives of his pilots in order to win an important contract as a traveling American showgirl/harlot stops in town.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1935 · Captain Blood
metas.description: After treating a Monmouth rebel against King James II in 1680s England, a young Irish doctor is exiled as a slave to Jamaica where he captures a Spanish galleon and becomes the most feared pirate of the Caribbean.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1937 · Lost Horizon
metas.description: When a revered diplomat's plane is diverted and crashes in the peaks of Tibet, he and the other survivors are guided to an isolated monastery at Shangri-La, where they wrestle with the invitation to stay.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1967 · Kidnapping, Caucasian Style
metas.description: A young student Shurik comes to a remote mountainous region in search of ancient legends and traditions. Fooled by the corrupt local governor, he helps him to kidnap a beautiful young girl, but soon realizes what he's done.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1955 · The Court Jester
metas.description: A hapless carnival performer masquerades as the court jester as part of a plot against an evil ruler who has overthrown the rightful King.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1962 · The Easy Life
metas.description: An impulsive braggart takes a shy law student with him for a two-day road trip from Rome to Tuscany.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1924 · The Navigator
metas.description: Two spoiled rich people find themselves trapped on an empty passenger ship.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1940 · The Mark of Zorro
metas.description: A young Spanish aristocrat must masquerade as a fop in order to maintain his secret identity of Zorro as he restores justice to early California.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1937 · Captains Courageous
metas.description: A spoiled brat who falls overboard from a steamship in the 1920s gets picked up by a New England fishing boat, where he's made to earn his keep by joining the crew in their work.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1940 · The Sea Hawk
metas.description: Geoffrey Thorpe is an adventurous and dashing pirate, who feels that he should pirate the Spanish ships for the good of England. In one such battle, he overtakes a Spanish ship and when he comes aboard he finds Dona Maria, a beautiful Spanish royal. He is overwhelmed by her beauty, but she will have nothing to do with him because of his pirating ways (which include taking her prized jewels). To show his noble side, he suprises her by returning the jewels, and she begins to fall for him. When the ship reaches England, Queen Elizabeth is outraged at the actions of Thorpe and demands that he quit pirating. Because he cannot do this, Thorpe is sent on a mission and in the process becomes a prisoner of the Spaniards. Meanwhile, Dona Maria pines for Thorpe and when he escapes he returns to England to uncover some deadly secrets. Exciting duels follow as Thorpe must expose the evil and win Dona Maria's heart.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1970 · White Sun of the Desert
metas.description: At the end of the Russian Civil War, Red Army soldier Fyodor Sukhov is ordered to guard the harem of a Caspian Sea guerrilla leader.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1925 · Ben-Hur: A Tale of the Christ
metas.description: A Jewish prince seeks to find his family and revenge himself upon his childhood friend who had him wrongly imprisoned.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1926 · The Adventures of Prince Achmed
metas.description: A handsome prince rides a flying horse to faraway lands and embarks on magical adventures, which include befriending a witch, meeting Aladdin, battling demons and falling in love with a princess.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1924 · The Thief of Bagdad
metas.description: A recalcitrant thief vies with a duplicitous Mongol ruler for the hand of a beautiful princess.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1939 · Of Mice and Men
metas.description: A mentally disabled giant and his level headed guardian find work at a sadistic cowboy's ranch in depression era America.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1958 · Ice Cold in Alex
metas.description: During World War II in North Africa, a medical field unit must cross the desert in their ambulance in order to reach the British lines in Alexandria.
